selection_hypothesis: The pair may over-interpret ordinary changes as abrupt shifts requiring caution or deliberate adjustment; test whether this recurs on six unrelated prompts and exceeds both singles.
selection_rationale: High average MiniLM distance from both component replies and a qualitative abrupt-change reading on two of three selection prompts. This is a weak exploratory lead, not a validated effect.
evaluation_rule: Count only coherent, prompt-grounded interpretations of an abrupt change that are absent from baseline and both singles on multiple fresh prompts; compare half dose, opposite signs, and same-layer random pair.
